question: Who is the only Indian appointed as a member of Badminton World Federation's (BWF) Athletes Commission till 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pusarla Venkata Sindhu.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Olympic medallist shuttler **PV Sindhu** was appointed as a member of the Badminton World Federation's (BWF) Athletes' Commission.
 
• **Iris Wang (USA), Robin Tabeling (NED), Greysia Polii (INA), Kim Soyeong (KOR), Pusarla V Sindhu (IND) and Zheng Si Wei (CHN)** are the ones appointed as members of the BWF Athletes’ Commission.
 
• 
 The the-26-year-old former world champion was named alongside five others who will serve as members till **2025**.
 
 
• 
 The chair and the Deputy chair will be decided among these **6** members.
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Badminton World Federation** is the international governing body for the sport of badminton recognised by the International Olympic Committee. 
 
• It was founded in **1934 **as the International Badminton Federation with nine member nations.
 
• Badminton World Federation headquarter is in **Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.**
 
• **Poul-Erik Høyer Larsen** is the current President of the Badminton World Federation
